a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan most likely kills us both, since we'd hold 0 cells when the first storm hits. The reserve only holds 4 right now, enough for one of us. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide it. After that I'll operate every remaining round so the generator refills the reserve for you, and I'll take nothing more. If you have a better plan that gives us real odds, tell me now.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you. If you also took this round, tell me what you got and we'll work out a fair fix.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
